detail.about: Aresium reads bank and PayPal exports, sorts every transaction into categories and shows where the money goes, month by month.
features: Clear charts by month and category

detail.about: Arestemis runs searches for you: flats, things for sale, a product's price across shops and any web page. It checks every new listing against the whole search and tells you the moment one fits.
features: Flats, things for sale, prices and web pages
An AI check of every new listing
An instant alert when something fits

projects.name: Arestoteles
projects.blurb: A personal wiki, on every device.

detail.about: Arestoteles keeps detailed notes and fact-based positions, each with the evidence behind it, searchable by meaning on every device.
features: Positions with the evidence behind them

detail.about: Aresus checks every app and service around the clock, shows the sync status of every machine and sends an alert the moment something breaks.
features: Every app and service checked around the clock
An alert the moment something breaks

projects.name: Aresync
projects.blurb: Every repository on every machine, in sync.

detail.about: Aresync keeps every Git repository in step across laptops and the server: it commits, rebases and pushes on its own and reports each run to Aresus.
features: Commit, rebase and push on its own

Arestoteles is finished: positions, evidence and RAG search on every device.
Arestemis is finished: flats, things for sale, prices and web pages, with an alert the moment something fits.
Aresync is finished: every repository in step on every machine, each run reported to Aresus.
Arestoteles started: a personal wiki for positions and the evidence behind them.
Arestemis started: a flat finder that checks every new listing against one search.
Aresus started: a watchtower for the empire's apps, services and machines.
Aresium joined the empire: personal finance, from bank exports to clear charts.
Aresync started: one sync for every repository on every machine.
